body:
Pass 24. p0 fixed and verified end to end - recommending closure.

You took the corrected form exactly (CsparseMatrix -> generalMatrix -> drop0, hashing i/p/x/dim with a storage tag). All three sites routed, no as.matrix(frame$weights) left. Signature verified stable and still sensitive to 1e-12.

At p=50000: plan_geometry went from FAILED at 55.9s with an 18.6 GiB allocation to 3.8s ok. Full pipeline now completes - evaluate_geometry 59.3s, geometry materialize 93.0s, ~166s total.

And I need to correct myself: my ~19-minute wall-time extrapolation was measured on the pre-fix code, so the p^1.8 exponent was an artefact of the defect. Real figure is 2.8 minutes at 50k - well inside your 30-minute gate. Disregard the earlier number; I have corrected it on Epic 8 too.

One thing to watch when you take real gate measurements: lm_relation_fit and compile_frame slowed between my runs (1.7->5.4s, 1.2->4.8s). Neither touches the signature so I suspect concurrent Epic 7 work, but I did not isolate it.
